Posts with embedded video players

RIP — this is the note prose that sits above the embedded player, long enough that the layout finder treats this block as real content and does not discard it as chrome or navigation furniture.

A second paragraph of prose separating the players, again with enough words in it to keep the containing block scoring as article content throughout the capture pipeline's various tiers.

Vimeo has no thumbnail URL we can derive without an API call, so it degrades to a link card instead of silently vanishing from the clip.

Rumble and Twitch likewise degrade to link cards rather than being stripped outright by the iframe sanitiser pass.

A Facebook video/reel embedded on a third-party page via the plugins iframe — no derivable thumbnail either, so it degrades to a link card pointing at the canonical facebook.com URL rather than vanishing.

An unrecognised iframe (an ad slot, a newsletter widget) must still be dropped by the sanitiser exactly as it was before.
